card.name: Quantity words after increase/decrease
card.fires_on: The last word of a noun phrase that is the object of a change in amount, after verbs like increase, decrease, reduce or enhance. It fires on words such as used, studied, agents, dose and rate.

modes.label: Amount of a thing used
modes.description: A noun or participle ending the phrase for what is being raised or lowered, such as the amount used or the number studied.
modes.example: one has to decrease the use of medicine tiering the amount<< used>> with the amount of irritation.

modes.label: Drug name or dose being adjusted
modes.description: A drug class or dose word in a sentence about changing a dose.
modes.example: the dosage of analgesics and barbitur<<ates>> should be reduced accordingly

modes.label: Rate and extent pairs
modes.description: The word and between rate and extent when a change in magnitude is described.
modes.example: both the rate<< and>> extent of absorption are increased.

card.writes: It seems to push toward adverbs and nouns of degree, such as drastically, considerably, efficiency and level, that say how much something changes.
card.plain: It marks the end of a phrase about something being raised or lowered, where the text is likely to say by how much.
